A test's results as tables.

Reads a test's per-row predictions (the test_predictions table, or a test kept as a file) and gives its metrics, confusion counts, per-class precision / recall / F1 and worst rows, the same figures as Data Studio > Results > Test.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `TestEvaluationNode` |
| Search words | test, evaluation, kept, confusion, metrics, accuracy, mae, worst rows |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | A test's per-row predictions (true_class / predicted_class, or true_value / predicted_value) |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Metrics** | Dataset | No | 1 | metric / value: accuracy, macro and weighted F1, AUC, or MAE, RMSE, bias; loss, rows |
| **Confusion** | Dataset | No | 1 | true / predicted / count (a classifier) |
| **Per class** | Dataset | No | 1 | class / rows / precision / recall / f1 (a classifier) |
| **Worst rows** | Dataset | No | 1 | The most confident mistakes, or the largest errors, by dataset row |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| worst_rows | `worst_rows` | Integer | `20` | `1-10000` | The run | How many worst rows to keep. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
